page.overview:
Who is Desanto?

Desanto was an InGen Employee working at a research facility on Ile Saint-Hubert. She witnessed Williams get eaten in an accident with the Distortus rex.

In 2010, Desanto was doing a procedure with Williams and other scientists in the Distortus rex pen. Williams' Snickers bar wrapper got sucked into an airlock for the pen's doors, which started a system failure and emergency closure of the doors. Her and the other scientists got out of the pen, but Williams did not make it out in time.

Desanto ran up to the door and put the key in to let Williams out, but saw the Distortus rex coming up behind him. She pulled the key out of the door, shaking. Williams plead with her to let him out, but she refused to risk the escape of the Distortus rex. The creature grabbed Williams, put him in its mouth as he was screaming, and turned around. She yelled she was sorry many times in emotional agony.
